name: WolfActionBits
meaning: wolf+0xd4 decoded input bits as used here (matches docs)

name: WOLF_ACT_RUN
meaning: ReadPad: PRESSED(pad, 9) -> bits |= 4; FilterInput removes it in RESTRICT_F_NO_RUN boxes, rabbit costume and WOLF_FB_SPECIAL_OBJECT

name: WOLF_ACT_DOUBLE_JUMP
meaning: ReadPad: PRESSED(pad, 11) -> bits |= 0x21; StateMachine: padBits & 0x20 -> DOUBLEJUMP_ASCEND / WATER_DOUBLEJUMP
